intro.title: Overview
paragraphs: BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) specializes in creating training data for AI (Artificial Intelligence) and processing image data.
With the rapid growth of AI, demand for training data is huge. Creating data for AI is a core part of the AI ecosystem.
High-quality, diverse, representative and well-managed data is the basis for powerful, reliable AI models. Customer information is strictly protected under our information security rules.

history.title: Our history
history.lead: We started in 2015 as a small project of about 15 people. Today the division operates with 550 people across 3 offices.

timeline.text: Started annotation work with a 15-person project.
Scaled up to 50 people, working on tagging data.
Recognition data for Japan's railway system. Grew to 150 people.
Received first 3D data orders and began segmentation data. Launched a policy to send staff to Japan to study and work.
Began Bounding Box and satellite data. Grew to 200 people.
Developed 3D Bounding Box. Grew to 550 people. Opened new offices at Pham Van Dong and Ly Thuong Kiet.

services.lead: We specialize in creating training data for AI. Our main work is image annotation using dedicated tools.
services.overview_note: We mainly handle two kinds of data: 3D and 2D. 3D data comes from LiDAR scanners; 2D data comes from dashcams mounted around the vehicle.

annotation.title: AI Training Data Creation
annotation.lead: We annotate images and point clouds so AI can learn to understand the real world — accurately, on time and securely.

items.title: 3D Segment
items.text: Labeling each point of a LiDAR point cloud by object class (road, vehicle, person…).

items.title: 3D Cuboid (3D Bounding Box)
items.text: Drawing 3D boxes around objects to define position, size and heading.

items.title: 2D Segment
items.text: Classifying every pixel of an image by object type.

items.title: 2D Bounding Box
items.text: Drawing rectangles around each object in an image.

items.title: Keypoint
items.text: Marking key points such as body joints for pose recognition.

items.title: Satellite data
items.text: Annotating objects in satellite imagery (e.g., aircraft, structures).

quality.title: Quality control
quality.text: Every project goes through quality checks at the interim and final stages, with feedback (FB) shared with the client.

collection.title: AI Training Data Collection
collection.lead: Collecting real-world data from sensors and cameras as raw material for AI training.

items.title: 2D data from dashcams
items.text: 2D (DashCam) data captured by dashcams mounted around the vehicle.

structure.title: Organization
structure.text: Driven by large-scale data demand, the division operates with a large workforce.

growth.title: Career growth opportunities
growth.text: Our dispatch program sends staff from Brycen VN to Brycen JP to study and work, building skills and experiencing Japanese workplace mindset and culture, then applying them back in the division.

awards.title: Achievements
awards.text: #1 in the Japanese market for AI training-data creation for 5 consecutive years — and aiming for a 6th.

projects.title: Projects
projects.text: As a long-standing #1, we serve many well-known customers in and outside Japan. We have completed 235 projects in total, including many long-term projects with Sony, Subaru, Denso, Sony Honda Mobility and Nikon.

direction.title: Direction
direction.text: We will keep growing our annotation business in scale and quality, beyond Japan. Next, our Japan headquarters will expand into the United States to seek new opportunities and customers.

recruit.title: People & recruitment
recruit.text: Hiring needs may grow to meet new challenges. We work closely with universities, colleges and local ward/commune authorities to recruit, so we can always staff large-scale projects.
